content.short: Veno Finance provides liquid staking for multiple tokens, including CRO and ATOM.
content.description: Veno Finance is a liquid staking protocol on Cronos that supports liquid staking for several tokens, including CRO and ATOM. By automating reward compounding, users can earn higher yields from proof-of-stake assets while sharing transaction costs. It offers liquid staking derivatives LCRO and LATOM, unlocking liquidity across the Cronos ecosystem and enabling use and swaps within it. When users unbond, the unbonding position is minted as a tradeable NFT, allowing the position to be traded out at any time.
